summary: Added a new, conditional fifth element to the practical-interpretation section: "Related News," populated by a new news-aggregator role into an optional, purely additive per-state XX_UAS_News.yaml file (no change to the 33-field source-register CSV schema). Structurally distinct from the four fixed AI-perspective panels (dashed left border, document-icon kicker, explicit informational-only disclaimer) rather than a fifth accent color, so the difference in kind does not rely on color alone. Unlike the four fixed perspectives -- which governance requires to always render, even as "Not applicable" -- a record with no genuinely on-topic, verified news simply omits the section entirely; this is the deliberate 'hide what has nothing useful' exception the user requested. Each news item carries an explicit in-state/out-of-state badge (text label plus solid-vs-dashed border, not color alone) and a relevance_note tying the story to that specific record's specific subject matter, per the new role's precision-over-recall governing instructions. Rendered in the Source Register accordion only in this iteration; not yet attached to the freeform narrative sections. agents/roles/web-ux-ui-editor.md bumped to 1.2.0 to document this governed exception.
